concept: Branding as something you can watch happen, rendered in 3D (Blender). Bars of bottle-green kelp soap for a made-up maker (Tidewrack Soap Co.) on a sand sweep. One locked close-up: a blank bar, good soap, no name; then the name presses into it. The same bar in its cream paper band: now it's a brand. Then banded bars standing in a row, arriving one at a time: let's brand yours. Sand, bottle green, cream paper.
